verdict.rationale: The axis applies, since LanceDB has hosted Enterprise offerings where a training-use policy or opt-out is a fair buyer question. The evidence pack contains no documented policy, setting, or contractual commitment preventing customer data from being used to train AI models. SOC 2, HIPAA and GDPR compliance claims and self-hosted storage options are adjacent privacy controls, not a training-use opt-out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
